name: PostgREST E2E Query Check
description: TEST-ONLY. Runs inside the postgrest LXC after the docker stack is up. Performs a real HTTP request to PostgREST which forces a query to PostgreSQL over the configured connection (mTLS for the mtls scenario). Fails the scenario if the seeded row does not come back — the definitive end-to-end proof of the PostgREST -> PostgreSQL path.
